title: LA Colossal – Minakari 05 (Seated)
prompt:
Subject: ONE extremely large SuperBBW Uzbek woman in her early 30s, long black hair in many thin braids with a small embroidered cap, natural face with a warm smile.

Physique: The most colossal SuperBBW physique physically possible — gigantic soft belly resting in multiple deep overlapping rolls over the thighs, not pregnant, overwhelmingly massive heavy bust resting on the upper belly, extremely wide hips filling the chair, enormous thick thighs, very broad soft arms, profound physical volume filling the entire frame width.

Body Art: Full body Persian minakari enamel body painting from neck to ankle, painted directly on bare skin, one continuous surface, no collar band. Glossy cobalt and turquoise enamel base with fine gold outlines, filled with pomegranates, birds, and arabesque vines. Pelvis, inner thighs, and both arms fully patterned.

Pose: Seated in a carved wooden armchair, torso turned open toward the camera, one forearm on the armrest, the other hand on her thigh, legs crossed at the knee. Arms kept away from the torso so the painted bust and belly are fully visible. Full body head to toe visible.

Footwear: Towering 9-inch caged cobalt enamel platform stiletto sandals with gold-tipped straps.
Nails: Extra long almond nails, turquoise with gold dots.

Background & Lighting: Bukhara courtyard with blue-tiled walls, softly blurred. Low camera angle, 85mm lens. Warm afternoon light with raking side light. ONE woman only. Figure fills 90% of the frame. Emphasis on the extremely large SuperBBW body volume. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait.
